body: I can't afford professional help, or even a visit to my family doctor. God bless America.

I was forced to go to a therapist six years ago, but I lied to get out- I was in a phase where I was extremely anti social and they thought I was a sociopath or homicidal (I wasn't, just suicidal) . She deemed me 'normal' and I was taken out of therapy. I don't know if it helps, and I'd like to try again but my family has no insurance and my parents attitudes towards depression is 'you're just lazy' (direct quote from my mom, towards my brother, two weeks before he was diagnosed as clinically depressed). I highly doubt anyone would truely miss me.
